Summary: To search doctors by speciality, hospital and language
Description: As a patient, I want to search doctors by speciality, hospital and language, so that I find the right doctor.

Summary: To see a doctor's free slots for the next 14 days
Description: As a patient, I want to see a doctor's free slots for the next 14 days, so that I can pick a convenient time.

Summary: To book a free slot and get a confirmation number
Description:
As a patient, I want to book a free slot and get a confirmation number, so that my appointment is guaranteed.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given Dr. Ramesh Iyer has a free slot at 10:30 on 20-Nov-2026 When I select 10:30 and confirm Then the slot is booked, I get confirmation number APT-48213 and an SMS
- Given another patient books the 10:30 slot while I am on the confirm screen When I tap confirm Then I see 'This slot was just taken' with the next 3 free slots, and no booking is created for me
- Given I already have an appointment at 10:30 on 20-Nov-2026 When I try to book another doctor at 10:30 the same day Then I see 'You already have an appointment at this time'

Summary: To pay the consultation fee online while booking
Description: As a patient, I want to pay the consultation fee online while booking, so that I skip the billing queue.

Summary: To book for a family member from my account
Description: As a patient, I want to book for a family member from my account, so that I can manage my parents' visits.

Summary: To reschedule my appointment to another free slot of the same doctor
Description:
As a patient, I want to reschedule my appointment to another free slot of the same doctor, so that I don't lose my booking when plans change.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given I have a booking at 10:30 and 12:00 is free When I move it to 12:00 Then 10:30 is freed, 12:00 is booked and the confirmation number stays the same
- Given 12:00 gets booked by someone else while I am rescheduling When I confirm 12:00 Then I see 'This slot was just taken' and my 10:30 booking is unchanged

Summary: To cancel my appointment up to 2 hours before the slot
Description:
As a patient, I want to cancel my appointment up to 2 hours before the slot, so that the slot is freed for someone else.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given my appointment is at 16:00 and it is now 11:00 When I cancel it Then the status becomes 'Cancelled', the slot shows as free and I get a cancellation SMS
- Given my appointment is at 16:00 and it is now 14:30 When I try to cancel Then I see 'Appointments can be cancelled up to 2 hours before' and the booking stays

Summary: To get a refund when I cancel a prepaid appointment
Description: As a patient, I want to get a refund when I cancel a prepaid appointment, so that I don't lose money.

Summary: An SMS and app reminder 24 hours and 2 hours before my appointment
Description: As a patient, I want an SMS and app reminder 24 hours and 2 hours before my appointment, so that I don't forget the visit.

Summary: To confirm or cancel from the reminder message
Description: As a patient, I want to confirm or cancel from the reminder message, so that I can respond in one tap.

Summary: To see my appointments for the day in order
Description: As a doctor, I want to see my appointments for the day in order, so that I can plan my clinic.

Summary: To block slots for leave or surgery
Description: As a doctor, I want to block slots for leave or surgery, so that patients cannot book when I'm unavailable.

Summary: To move all of a doctor's patients to another doctor when the doctor is absent
Description: As a receptionist, I want to move all of a doctor's patients to another doctor when the doctor is absent, so that patients are still seen.
